segments.text: How much of your life is spent filling in forms? The same name, the same address, the same date of birth, over and over. PolyglotFormFill does it for you, in seconds, in twenty-six languages, and entirely on your own device. Let me show you.
Getting started takes a moment. Activate your licence with a single key, verified right here on your device, never on a server. During the beta, every feature is unlocked and free.

Create a profile for whoever you are filling forms as. Here is John Doe. Now, instead of typing every detail, just capture an ID. Take a photo of a driving licence or passport, or upload one you already have.

On-device text recognition reads it and turns it into your vault automatically. Name, date of birth, licence number, address, all captured in one shot, and all kept encrypted on your device. Your profile is built in seconds, not minutes of typing.
Now the forms. Start with the worst kind. A flat P D F. A scan with no boxes to type in. Normally that means printing it, filling it by hand, and scanning it back. Tedious work, every single time.

Watch what happens instead. PolyglotFormFill reads the page on your device, finds every place that needs an answer, and builds real, fillable fields where there were none. A dead scan becomes a live form, in seconds, with no printing and no scanner.

Now the part that saves your day. One click. Every field filled from your secure vault. Name, address, date of birth, ID numbers, all in the right place, instantly. And not only text boxes. Drop-downs, radio buttons and tick-boxes are answered too. What used to take ten minutes now takes one second.

It even places your photo and your signature onto the form, exactly where they belong. No more printing a picture, cutting it out, and gluing it into a box. Your passport photo and signature drop straight in.
Anything the form asks that is new, you simply type once, and PolyglotFormFill remembers it for next time. Every form you fill makes the next one faster.

And it is not only your details. Keep a separate profile for each person, or each purpose. One for yourself, one for your spouse, one for each child, so a school or medical form for any of them fills without typing it all again. At the office it is a game-changer. A profile for inventory forms, another for finance forms, another for vendor paperwork, each holding exactly the right data. You pick the profile, the form fills correctly, and the mix-ups that come from copying between forms simply stop. Right data, right form, every time.

When the form is ready, sign it right on the page. Draw your signature by hand, in any ink colour, because plenty of offices insist on blue. Or drop in a signature you saved earlier. Either way it is backed by your device's own key, proving the document is genuinely from you.

And it is not just P D Fs. Add the browser extension for Chrome or Edge, and any online form fills in a single click too, from the very same vault. Web forms, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets. If it asks for your details, PolyglotFormFill fills it.

Faced with a form in a language you do not read? It is translated for you on the spot, and you can write your answers in the language of your choice. The entire app speaks your language too. Twenty-six of them.

Every finished form is saved, encrypted and versioned, ready to download again whenever you need it. And all of this, the reading, the filling, the signing, happens on your device. We never see your forms or your data. Stop filling forms by hand. Get PolyglotFormFill, and get your time back.
